studyNotes: God gave us the 10 Commandments to follow so we can love God and others.
The 1st Great Commandment: You shall love the Lord your God with all your heart, with all your soul, with all your mind, and with all your strength.
Ways to pray include traditional prayer, talking to God, songs, Mass, the Bible, and Psalms.
Commandment 1: Pray and put God first.
Commandment 2: Say God's name with love.
subjects.subject: Religion
topics: Story of Moses and the Burning Bush

studyNotes: Reading comprehension focuses on predictions, character traits, plot/sequence of events, and using text and picture clues.
Phonics skills include soft c, soft g, and digraphs like ch, tch, sh, ph, th, ng, and wh.
Word structure study includes prefixes re-, un-, and dis-, and suffixes -less and -ful.

pack.summary: This week, students are exploring the 1st Great Commandment and the story of Moses in Religion, while focusing on long 'a' vowel patterns in Spelling. In Reading, the class is studying fables like 'The Boy Who Cried Wolf' and practicing phonics including soft c, soft g, and various digraphs. Note the upcoming Thanksgiving break and early dismissal on Wednesday.
